env.name: AD_IMAGE_PROVIDER
env.description: Which image model actually generates: "openai" (default) or "google" (Nano Banana 2 / Nano Banana Pro). Only one provider's API key below is required, matching whichever you pick.

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: OpenAI API key — required when AD_IMAGE_PROVIDER=openai (the default).

env.name: OPENAI_IMAGE_MODEL
env.description: Which OpenAI image model to call. Defaults to gpt-image-2.5-sunburst if unset (best fit for this ability's edit-based workflow, which composites a real product photo into an ad rather than generating a scene from scratch). gpt-image-2.5-flare is available for faster, lower-precision generation.

env.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
env.description: Google AI Studio / Gemini API key — required when AD_IMAGE_PROVIDER=google.

env.name: GOOGLE_IMAGE_MODEL
env.description: Which Gemini image model to call when AD_IMAGE_PROVIDER=google: gemini-3.1-flash-image (Nano Banana 2, the default) or gemini-3-pro-image (Nano Banana Pro, higher quality and cost).

env.name: AD_IMAGE_OUTPUT_DIR
env.description: Where job-status files always live, and where generated images are written when AD_IMAGE_STORAGE=local. Defaults to ./generated/ad-images if unset.

env.name: AD_IMAGE_STORAGE
env.description: Where generated images are saved: "local" (default, under AD_IMAGE_OUTPUT_DIR) or "gcs" (a Google Cloud Storage bucket). Job-status files stay local either way.

env.name: AD_IMAGE_GCS_BUCKET
env.description: GCS bucket name to upload generated images to — required when AD_IMAGE_STORAGE=gcs. Auth is via Application Default Credentials / GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS, same as any other Google Cloud client.

env.name: AD_IMAGE_GCS_PREFIX
env.description: Optional object name prefix inside the GCS bucket (e.g. "campaigns/summer/"). Only used when AD_IMAGE_STORAGE=gcs.

env.name: AD_IMAGE_GCS_SIGNED_URL_EXPIRY
env.description: How long (in seconds) a generated image's signed GCS URL stays valid. Defaults to 604800 (7 days, the GCS-imposed maximum for V4 signed URLs) if unset. Only used when AD_IMAGE_STORAGE=gcs and the configured credentials can actually sign — falls back to a bare gs:// URI otherwise.

env.name: AD_IMAGE_CONCURRENCY
env.description: Max number of image generations run at once within a single batch job. Defaults to 4 if unset — raise it for faster batches if your provider quota allows, lower it if you're hitting rate limits.
